Step9 failed with98 successful smoke checks and5 failed assertions in the text-input sequence. Initial preedit arrived; the first Chinese commit did not; later commit of an exclamation point and physical key input did arrive, leaving expected prefix absent.
All rendering, window, popup, clipboard, drag-and-drop and decoration checks within this EGL step passed.
In the same job, shm at scales1,2,1.5, EGL at scales2 and1.5, dmabuf fallback, ControlCatalog popup/IME and automatic Wayland selection steps passed.
Same-input main and prior native-promotion branch EGL steps each passed103 checks.
No Wayland or scripts/wayland source changes exist between main171a and the failing PR merge2041; the only ci.yml difference adds a source-convention scanner step in another job.

hypothesis.description: An intermittent IME serial/quiescence race is consistent with the failure, but not established by the available log.
source_evidence: wayland_window.rs:1950-1963 waits for one unchanged150ms interval of input-method done_count before sending.
wayland_window.rs:1017-1035 syncs then commits with observed input-method done_count.
wayland_text_input_v3.rs:570-588 discards a batch whose done serial does not match the most recent client commit.
limits: The log contains no verbose dropped-batch serial values, so neither stale-serial rejection nor infrastructure failure is proved.
The measured350ms successful preedit-to-commit interval and5.200s failing interval describe observed timestamps; they do not independently reveal when a protocol serial changed.
Do not change protocol behavior or loosen tests from this circumstantial evidence.
